name: Mechanosoldier deepens and lengthens Kinetic Shield (#735)
contract: #735: Mechanosoldier 705827 is a native ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107) passive. Effect 0 is EffectMiscValue 3 SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, BasePoints -11 DieSides 1 (-10); effect 1 is EffectMiscValue 1 SPELLMOD_DURATION, BasePoints 1999 DieSides 1 (+2000 ms); both carry EffectSpellClassMask (0,0,1024) = family-34 flag bit 74. Kinetic Shield 806224 has SpellFamilyName 34, SpellFamilyFlags (0,0,1024), AttributesEx3 0, DurationIndex 31 (SpellDuration.dbc row 31 = 8000 ms) and effect 0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN with BasePoints -41 DieSides 1 and EffectRealPointsPerLevel 0, i.e. -40. SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 is a flat term applied to effect index 0 in Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers, so the amount becomes -50, and Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies SPELLMOD_DURATION, so the aura lasts 10000 ms. The live calculator snapshot renders the tooltip literally as "by -10% and its duration by 2 sec", which confirms the negative flat amount is the authored contract. Effect 2 (SPELL_AURA_DUMMY, EffectMiscValue 1, amount 6000, mask (0,2,0)) is undescribed and has no native handler; it is deliberately not asserted.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Kinetic Shield reduces damage taken by 40% without Mechanosoldier
Mechanosoldier deepens Kinetic Shield's reduction to 50%
Kinetic Shield lasts 8 sec without Mechanosoldier
Mechanosoldier lengthens Kinetic Shield to 10 sec
Apply Kinetic Shield with the unmodified Tinker as its caster
Apply Kinetic Shield with Mechanosoldier as its caster
The applied shield carries -40% damage taken without the talent
Mechanosoldier's applied shield carries -50% damage taken
The applied shield lasts 8 sec without the talent
